what: Streaming C++ port of the D-STAR pitch-correction and band-energy analysis (MBELIB_DSTAR_PITCH_ANALYSIS, src/encoder/dstar_analysis.cpp) against the offline reference of 22-23 September (build/dstar-analysis prototype.py energy_grid + build/dstar-perception analysis.py tracked_pitch), both on top of MBELIB_DSTAR_WEIGHTED_QUANTIZER, on the 536 ladder inputs (134 recordings x 4 framings, dstar_ladder_inputs.py)

files_differing_elsewhere.OSR_us_000_0014__f40: from frame 417, pitch unchanged: spectral indices differ, a rounding tie (the reference passes targets through %.9g text)
files_differing_elsewhere.libri_3729-6852-0001__f0: from frame 3: the reference low-passes the padded file and keeps the filter pre-ringing before time zero (corr 0.702 against the 0.7 gate), the unpadded reference and the stream zero it (0.700)

tail_cause: the reference zero-fills the signal after the end of the file; a stream keeps the DC blocker tail through the encoder flush frames
other_codecs_with_option_on: AMBE+2, raw 2450, IMBE 7200, IMBE 4400 byte-identical to the default build (16 of 16)
default_build_unchanged: 77 of 77 sampled D-STAR files byte-identical after the voicing-row refactor
run_time: 15 s D-STAR encode, median wall time: default 0.190 s, weighted 0.208 s, weighted+analysis 0.369 s (41x real time)
tests: 15/15 on MSVC with and without the option and on Cygwin GCC (warnings as errors) with and without it
